DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ベビーカーをこちらへ置かれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will you be leaving your stroller here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。子どもが寝たので、妻と交代で少し走りたいです。そばで待つ時、どこなら通路をふさぎませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 寝た子のそばに親が残り交代走する待機位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Our child has fallen asleep, so my wife and I would like to take turns running a little. Where can we wait nearby without blocking the path?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where to wait while one parent stays beside the sleeping child and the parents take turns running. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ベンチの横へ寄せてください。保護者の方は、お子様のそばにいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please move it beside the bench. A parent or guardian should stay beside your child.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらへ寄せます。私が先に走り、妻が子どものそばで待つ予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 指定場所へ寄せ本人先走り妻見守りの順を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will move it here. I plan to run first while my wife waits beside our child.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Move to the designated place and say you will run first while your wife watches the child. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お戻りになってから、交代してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please switch after you have returned.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。一周戻って、妻に声をかけてから代わります。途中で走る方向を変えると会いにくそうですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一周帰還して声掛け後に交代すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will come back after one lap and speak to my wife before we switch. Changing direction midway would seem to make meeting up harder.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will return after one lap and speak to your wife before switching. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 戻る場所も、お二人で確かめておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also agree with each other on where you will return.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: このベンチへ戻ると伝えました。私は携帯を持つので、子どもが起きたら連絡してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同じベンチを帰還場所に決め携帯で連絡を受ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I told her I will return to this bench. I will carry my phone, so she can contact me if our child wakes up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the same bench as the return point and arrange to receive a phone call. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お子様の様子に合わせ、無理のない範囲でご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please use the facilities within a comfortable limit, according to your child's condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。起きて泣いたら戻ります。今日は二人で同じ距離を走ることより、子どもの様子を優先します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 泣いたら戻り同距離運動より子の様子を優先する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will come back if our child wakes and cries. Today we will prioritize our child's condition over both running the same distance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will return if the child cries and prioritize the child over exercising the same distance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、ご家族でお過ごしください。運動もお気をつけて。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please enjoy your time with your family. Take care while exercising too. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何かございましたか。こちらでお話を伺いましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Has something happened? Shall we listen to you here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ホームで知らない人に体を触られました。周りの人に聞かれない所で、駅員さんに相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ホームで身体に触られ私的な相談場所を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: A stranger touched my body on the platform. I want to speak to station staff somewhere other people cannot overhear.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report being touched on the platform and request a private place for consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 職員へおつなぎします。今、その方が近くにいるか分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will connect you with a staff member. Do you know whether that person is nearby now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりません。列車へは乗らず、ここまで来ました。一人で探しに戻るのは怖いです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 相手の所在不明で未乗車のまま係員へ来たと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I do not know. I did not get on the train; I came here. I am afraid to go back and look for them on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you do not know the person's whereabouts and came to staff without boarding the train. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 戻らずこちらでお待ちください。必要な相談を担当へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please wait here without going back. We will direct you to the person who can help with the consultation you need.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。仕事に遅れることも気になりますが、何もなかったことにして電車に乗りたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 仕事遅刻は気になるが相談を先にしたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I am also worried about being late for work, but I do not want to get on the train as if nothing happened.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that although you are concerned about being late for work, you want to seek advice first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 会社への連絡をするため、お待ちいただく場所も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will also check a place for you to wait so you can contact your workplace.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会社には遅れるとだけ伝えます。詳しい出来事は、まず担当の方へ話したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会社へは遅れのみ伝え出来事は担当へ話すと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will only tell work that I will be late. I want to tell the person in charge the details of what happened first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you will only tell work about being late and tell the person in charge what happened. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご自身の希望も、担当へお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Please also tell the person in charge your own wishes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 人の少ない所で話したいことと、一人でホームへ戻りたくないことを伝えます。案内をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 人の少ない相談場所と一人で戻らない希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will say I want to talk somewhere with few people and do not want to return to the platform alone. Please show me where to go.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for a consultation place with few people and say you do not want to return alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当を呼びます。こちらでお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will call the person in charge. Please wait here. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 結婚に関する書類のご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like advice about marriage-related documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 外国で結婚の書類を受け取りました。日本での手続きを相談したいのですが、どの担当へ行けばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 国外結婚書類の日本での相談担当を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I received marriage documents abroad. I want advice on the procedures in Japan. Which person in charge should I see?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask which office handles consultation in Japan about overseas marriage documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 戸籍などの担当へおつなぎします。書類の原本はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will connect you with the staff handling family registers and related matters. Do you have the original documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、この封筒にあります。まだ自分で日本語の説明を添えただけなので、正式な翻訳として出せるかは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 原本と自己作成日本語メモを示し正式翻訳可否は未確認と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, they are in this envelope. So far I have only added an explanation in Japanese myself, so I do not know whether it can be submitted as an official translation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the originals and your own Japanese notes, and say it is unconfirmed whether these qualify as an official translation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な書類や翻訳の条件は、担当へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the required documents and translation requirements with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。日本語の名前の書き方も、夫と相談中です。自分で書類の原本を直さず、そのまま見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 夫婦の日本語氏名表記未決で原本を改変せず提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please help me. I am still discussing with my husband how to write our names in Japanese. I will show the original documents as they are, without altering them myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the couple's Japanese name spellings are undecided and present the originals without altering them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご夫婦の状況も、担当が伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will also ask about your situation as a couple.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は私だけ来ました。夫が一緒に来る必要があるか、次の来庁の前に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人のみ来庁で次回夫同行の必要を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I came alone today. Before my next visit, I want to ask whether my husband needs to come with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you came alone and ask whether your husband must accompany you next time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 同行や確認に必要な物を担当へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please ask the person in charge about accompaniment and anything needed for checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 原本と自分のメモを分けて出します。翻訳の条件と夫の同行について説明を聞き、準備してから手続きしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 原本メモを分け翻訳と同行条件確認後に準備する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will present the originals and my notes separately. I want to hear the explanation about translation requirements and my husband's attendance, then prepare before completing the procedure.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate the originals and notes and prepare after checking translation and accompaniment requirements. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当窓口へどうぞ。ご相談ありがとうございました。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please go to the relevant counter. Thank you for consulting us. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 検査の前に、伝えておきたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you would like to tell us before the test?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 前の検査で注射の後に発疹が出たことがあります。今日の検査の前に、そのことを相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 過去検査の注射後発疹を当日の検査前に申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I once developed a rash after an injection during a previous test. I want to discuss that before today's test.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Before today's test, report a rash after an injection during a past test. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 担当へ伝えます。前の検査の名前や資料は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will tell the person in charge. Do you know the name of the previous test, or have any documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 名前は覚えていません。別の病院の紙が家にありますが、今日は持ってきていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 検査名不明で別院資料は自宅にあると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I do not remember the name. I have a paper from another hospital at home, but I did not bring it today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you do not know the test name and the other hospital's document is at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分かる範囲で、いつどのようになったか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell me as much as you know about when and what happened.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 去年の春、帰宅してから腕に赤い所が増えました。注射が原因だと医師に言われたかは、はっきり覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 前年春の帰宅後の発疹と原因認定の記憶不明を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Last spring, after I got home, more red areas appeared on my arms. I do not clearly remember whether a doctor told me the injection caused it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report the rash after returning home last spring and uncertainty about whether the cause was confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 原因が確認できているかどうかも、そのままお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will pass on exactly whether the cause has been confirmed or not as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。自分で薬の名前を決めてアレルギー欄へ書かず、経験したことを説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 薬名を自己断定せず経験した症状を説明すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I will explain what I experienced rather than decide a medicine name myself and write it in the allergy section.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will explain the symptoms experienced without deciding a medicine name yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 資料の確認や今日の検査について、担当からご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will guide you on checking the documents and today's test.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。家族に紙の所在も聞けます。担当の確認が済むまで、注射の案内に進まず待ちたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族へ資料所在を聞き担当確認まで待つ希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I can also ask my family where the paper is. I would like to wait without moving on to the injection instructions until the person in charge has finished checking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you can ask your family where the document is and want to wait until the person in charge checks. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、担当へおつなぎします。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will connect you with the person in charge. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 免許に関するご相談ですか。お持ちの資料を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this a question about a driving licence? Please tell me what documents you have.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 外国の免許を更新中です。古い免許の写真しか手元にないのですが、日本での運転について相談するには何を用意すればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 国外免許更新中で旧免許写真しかなく日本での相談準備を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: My foreign licence is being renewed. I only have a photo of the old licence with me. What should I prepare to ask about driving in Japan?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your overseas licence is being renewed and you only have a photo of the old one, and ask how to prepare for consultation in Japan. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 免許の担当へ確認してください。元の免許の原本は、お持ちではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check with the licensing staff. You do not have the original licence, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 原本は母国の更新窓口へ渡しました。新しい免許はまだ受け取っていません。こちらは更新を申し込んだ時の紙です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 原本は母国更新窓口で新免許未受領と更新受付紙を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I handed the original to the renewal office in my home country. I have not received the new licence yet. This is the paper from when I applied for renewal.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the original is at the home-country renewal office and the new licence is not received, and show the renewal application paper. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 原本の所在と更新中の状況を、担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell the person in charge where the original is and that renewal is in progress.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。写真があるから前と同じように使えるとは決めず、新しい物を受け取る前に相談できるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 写真を自己判断で使わず新免許受領前の相談可否を聞きたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will not assume the photo can be used just like before. I want to ask whether I can consult you before receiving the new licence.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not use the photo on your own judgment and want to ask about consultation before receiving the new licence. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 相談の時期と必要な資料も、担当がご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will also explain when to consult and what documents are needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人の車を運転する予定を頼まれましたが、まだ返事をしていません。更新が終わったかと、日本での条件は別に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人車運転の返答を保留し国外更新と日本条件を別確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have been asked to drive a friend's car, but have not answered yet. I will check separately whether renewal is complete and the conditions for driving in Japan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you are holding off answering about driving your friend's car and will check overseas renewal and Japanese conditions separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご本人の状況と資料を担当へお見せください。ここでは写真の有効性を判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please show your situation and documents to the person in charge. We cannot determine the validity of the photo here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 古い写真と更新の紙を分けて見せます。原本は今なく新しい免許も未受領と伝え、準備と相談時期の案内を聞いてから友人へ返事をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 旧写真と更新紙を分け原本なし未受領を明示し準備相談時期を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show the old photo and renewal paper separately. I will explain I do not currently have the original and have not received the new licence. I will reply to my friend after hearing what to prepare and when to consult.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate the old photo and renewal paper, clarify that the original is unavailable and the new licence not received, and check preparations and consultation timing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、免許を担当する窓口へご案内します。資料をお持ちください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will direct you to the licensing counter. Please bring your documents. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 返送用のお荷物でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this a parcel for return shipping?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人が帰国するので、この荷物を代わりに出してほしいと頼まれました。返送ラベルがこちらで使えるか見てほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人から預かった返送ラベルの利用先を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: A friend is returning to their home country and asked me to send this parcel for them. I would like you to check whether this return label can be used here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where to use the return label entrusted to you by your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表示の配送会社を確認しましょう。中身の説明もお分かりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the delivery company shown. Do you also know how to describe the contents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 服だと聞きましたが、私は箱を閉める所を見ていません。友人へ確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 服との説明は聞いたが梱包未確認と申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I was told it contains clothes, but I did not see the box being closed. I can check with my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you were told it contains clothes but have not checked the packing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 送り方と内容を確認してからお手続きください。このラベルは別の配送会社の案内です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please confirm the shipping method and contents before proceeding. This label refers to a different delivery company.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それなら、宛名があるだけでこちらへ出せると思わず、その会社の受付先を調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別会社表示を受け指定会社の受付先を調べると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will look up that company's acceptance location, rather than assume I can leave it here just because it has an address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: After learning it is another company's label, say you will find the designated company's acceptance location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ラベルを発行した所の案内も、ご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also check the instructions from the place that issued the label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人に元のメールを送ってもらいます。返送の期限と受付方法を読んで、分からない所は発行元へ聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 元メールで期限受付方法を読み発行元へ不明点を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will ask my friend to forward the original email. I will read the return deadline and acceptance method, then ask the issuer about anything unclear.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Read the deadline and acceptance method in the original email and ask the issuer about unclear points. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらでは、別の会社の受付条件は確定できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We cannot confirm another company's acceptance conditions here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。箱をここへ置かず持ち帰り、友人に中身も確認してから指定の方法で出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 箱を持帰り中身確認後指定方法で発送する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will take the box home instead of leaving it here, check the contents with my friend, then send it by the specified method.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Take the box home and send it by the specified method after checking the contents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お荷物をお持ちください。お問い合わせありがとうございました。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take your parcel with you. Thank you for your inquiry. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 積立についてのご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like advice about regular savings contributions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 来月から収入が減るので、毎月の積立額を見直したいです。変更をいつから始められるか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 来月減収に備え積立額変更の開始時期を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My income will decrease next month, so I want to reconsider my monthly savings amount. Please tell me when a change can start.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask when a change to savings contributions can begin in preparation for lower income next month. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 現在の契約と処理の状況を担当が確認します。契約の分かる資料はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The person in charge will check your current contract and processing status. Do you have a document showing your contract?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この控えです。毎月の金額が書いてありますが、今月の引き落としが済んだかは、まだ確かめていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 契約控えを提示し今月処理済みかは未確認と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: This is my copy. It shows the monthly amount, but I have not yet checked whether this month's debit has been completed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the contract copy and explain that this month's processing status is unconfirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今月の処理状況も、担当へ確認しましょう。新しい金額はお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us also check this month's processing with the person in charge. Have you decided the new amount?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。先に家賃と生活費を計算したいので、変更の方法と時期を聞いてから家で考えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新額未定で方法時期の説明後に生活費家賃を計算したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. I want to calculate rent and living expenses first, so I would like to hear how and when to change it, then think it over at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the new amount is undecided and you want to calculate rent and living expenses after hearing the method and timing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今日は説明をお聞きになるご希望として伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will tell them that today you would like to hear an explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。今後の金額変更と、今月すでに処理された分の扱いは、別に説明してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 将来の金額変更と今月既処理分を別に説明してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. Could they explain future changes to the amount separately from how any amount already processed this month will be handled?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for separate explanations of future amount changes and this month's already processed portion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その二点を担当へ伝えます。ご質問をメモしてお持ちいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will tell the person in charge those two points. You can write down your questions and bring them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: メモしました。変更を始められる月と今月の処理を確認し、持ち帰った説明を見て新しい額を考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二質問をメモし説明を持帰って新額を検討する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have written them down. I will check the month a change can begin and this month's processing, then consider a new amount using the explanation I take home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Write down the two questions and take the explanation home to consider a new amount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、控えとメモをお持ちください。担当窓口へご案内します。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please bring your copy and notes. I will direct you to the relevant counter. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お魚のお買い物で、ご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have any requests for your fish purchase?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 包装を減らしたくて、家からふた付きの容器を持ってきました。魚をこちらに入れてもらって買えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 包装削減のため持参容器への魚の受渡しを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I brought a container with a lid from home to reduce packaging. Could I buy fish with it placed in this container?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to receive the fish in your own container to reduce packaging. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの売場では、お持ち込みの容器へ入れてお渡しする対応はしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: At this counter, we do not place purchases in containers customers bring.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。自分で店の包装を開けて移してから、レジへ持って行くこともしない方がよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 取扱い不可を受け自己開封移替えもしないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I should not open the store's packaging and move it myself before taking it to the checkout either, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge the service is unavailable and confirm you will not open and transfer it yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。商品は店の包装のままお会計へお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Correct. Please take the product to checkout in the store's packaging.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この容器はかばんへ戻します。包装はそのままにして、持ち帰りの袋だけ自分の物を使いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 容器を収納し包装維持で自分の袋のみ使いたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will put this container back in my bag. I want to leave the packaging intact and just use my own bag to carry it home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Put the container away and say you want to keep the packaging and only use your own bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お会計後、お持ちの袋をご利用いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: You may use your own bag after checkout.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 袋は洗って乾いています。魚を外のトレーから出さず、袋へ入れて持ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 乾いた袋へ商品トレーを保ったまま入れると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: The bag has been washed and is dry. I will carry the fish in the bag without taking it out of its outer tray.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will place the product in a dry bag with its tray intact. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの商品でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Is this the product you would like?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、この一つを買います。次からは先に対応を聞いて、使えない容器を店で開かずに持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一商品を買い次回は容器対応を先に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I will buy this one item. Next time I will ask about the service first, and take any unusable container home without opening it in the store.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Buy one product and say you will check the container policy first next time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: かしこまりました。それでは、店の包装のままレジへどうぞ。ありがとうございました。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please go to checkout with the store's packaging intact. Thank you. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 催しの準備について、ご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like advice about preparing an event?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 小さな結婚のお祝いでテントを使いたいです。地面へ杭を打つことも、申込みで相談する必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 祝いのテント設置前に杭打ちの相談必要を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to use a tent for a small wedding celebration. Do I also need to discuss driving stakes into the ground when applying?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Before setting up a celebration tent, ask whether driving stakes needs to be discussed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 設備の設置と地面の扱いは、担当へご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check equipment installation and treatment of the ground with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。芝生なら自由に打てると思っていましたが、場所を決める前に相談します。まだ何も持ち込んでいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 芝生自由使用と思わず未持込と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I thought I could freely drive stakes into grass, but I will ask before choosing a location. I have not brought anything in yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Do not assume grass can be used freely, and say you have brought nothing in yet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: テントの大きさや、予定する人数を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell me the tent's size and the planned number of people.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 三メートルくらいの物で、十人です。風がある日の扱いも、私たちだけで決めず確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 寸法人数と風時の扱いを担当へ確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is about three metres, and there will be ten people. I also want to check what to do on windy days rather than decide by ourselves.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the dimensions and number of people and say you want to check windy-day arrangements with the person in charge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 安全や設置の条件について、主催者として担当の案内を受けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: As the organizer, please obtain guidance from the person in charge about safety and installation conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。許可が出るまでは地面に印を付けず、図で希望の配置を示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 地面の印付けをせず配置図で相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. Until permission is given, I will not mark the ground and will show the desired layout in a drawing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Consult using a layout drawing without marking the ground. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 申込みの内容と、できる範囲を担当と相談しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please discuss your application and what is possible with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 図とテントの説明を持ってきます。設置できなければ、別の会場も考えてから家族へ案内を出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 図設備説明を用意し可否後に会場と案内を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will bring a drawing and a description of the tent. If it cannot be set up, I will consider another venue before sending information to my family.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Prepare a drawing and equipment description, and decide the venue and invitations after checking permission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: テントの設置条件は担当へお尋ねください。それでは、申込みの窓口へご案内します。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23232-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please ask the person in charge about tent installation conditions. I will direct you to the application counter. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 運行について、お確かめでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to check train operations?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 駅の外で、知らない人に列車は全部止まったから車で送ると言われました。本当の運行をここで確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 知らぬ相手の全運休と車送迎の話を駅案内で確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Outside the station, a stranger told me all trains had stopped and offered to drive me. I want to check the actual train service here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check with station information a stranger's claim that all trains stopped and offer of a car ride. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 駅の案内で確認しましょう。お相手は、職員と名乗っていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the station information. Did that person identify themselves as staff?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 職員とは言っていません。車に乗れば五百円と言われましたが、まだ乗らず、お金も払っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 職員を名乗らず五百円提示だが未乗車未払と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: They did not say they were staff. They said the car ride would cost 500 yen, but I have not got in or paid anything.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say they did not identify as staff and quoted 500 yen, but you have neither boarded nor paid. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どちらへ向かうご予定ですか。ご利用の列車について、現在の案内を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Where are you planning to go? I will check current information for the train you need.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人の住む駅へ行く予定です。駅名はこのメモに書きました。知らない人の「全部」という言葉だけで、どの列車も使えないとは決めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 目的駅を示し全列車不可を伝聞のみで断定しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I plan to go to the station where my friend lives. I wrote its name in this note. I have not concluded no trains can be used just because a stranger said all of them had stopped.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show your destination station and avoid deciding all trains are unavailable based only on hearsay. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今の案内では、その方面の列車は運休になっていません。こちらの表示でもご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: According to current information, trains in that direction are not suspended. Please also check this display.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 表示を見ました。相手へ運行の説明をしてもらうより、ここで案内された列車を利用したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 駅表示を確認し相手の車でなく案内列車を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have looked at the display. I would prefer to use the train explained here rather than have that person explain train operations to me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the station display and choose the indicated train instead of the person's car. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お相手とのやり取りで、ご不安なことがあればお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell us if anything about your interaction with that person worries you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今はここに来られています。車へ戻って乗る約束はしていません。困ることが続けば職員へ伝え、まずこの駅の案内で移動を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 相手へ戻る約束なしで困れば職員へ相談し公式案内で移動を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have been able to come here now. I have not promised to return to the car and get in. If difficulties continue, I will tell staff. First, I will decide my travel using this station's information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you made no promise to return to the person, will consult staff if problems continue, and will decide travel using official information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご利用の列車の案内を続けます。それでは、こちらの表示をご覧ください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will continue explaining the train you need. Please look at this display. Goodbye.
